title: Finance color sensitivity versus medical and legal websites
statement:
Color sensitivity was larger in finance websites than in medical or legal websites in the Alberts and van der Geest experiment, so fintech landing pages have stronger evidence-based reason to compare multiple primary color systems rather than treating brand color as a fixed visual detail. (ResearchGate)

Options:
- Blue-first variant: blue-dominant (fits: trust, security, professional)
- Green-first variant: green-dominant (fits: stability, growth, calm)
- Red-first variant: red-dominant (fits: urgency, energy, action)
- Black-first variant: black-dominant (fits: formal, dramatic, premium)
appliesWhen: Applies to: fintech, health, legal. Audience: adults, b2b buyers, general.

source.title: Color matters: color as trustworthiness cue in web sites
source.authors: Wouter A. Alberts; Thea van der Geest
